verdict.rationale: Llama has no vendor-held user data store, so the evidence speaks to portability rather than data export. Weights download in both the original Meta format and the open Hugging Face transformers format, run locally on many runtimes (llama.cpp, ExecuTorch, desktop OSes), and are offered by many interchangeable hosting partners. That means a user is not locked to Meta and can move between providers or self-host. Missing for 10: any documented export of user data such as conversations or fine-tunes from Meta-hosted surfaces, independent hands-on confirmation of migrating off a host, and freely accessible terms (weights are gated behind license acceptance and docs sit behind an SSO wall).
